name: Worcester Country Club
architects: Donald Ross (1913-14); restoration by Gil Hanse and Jim Wagner

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (3DEPElevation exportImage, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21, leaf-off spring 2021), x 270100-271600 / y 4688600-4690400 EPSG:32619, NAVD88 metres, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-worcester_cc)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (leaf-off spring 2021), 5 tiles, classes 3-5 clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz (CRS kept); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-worcester_cc)
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

scorecard_source: Third-party (private club): Stymie's card (par, men's handicap and eleven tee rows; Red the tips at 6,711), read 2026-11-13; every row adds up. Ratings from the same card (Red 74.0/133, Black men's 70.8/128). Other sites print older totals (Black 6,422 71.7/130; Gold 6,711 72.8/134). Unverified against the club's printed card.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar)
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Red, the tips) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; inland New England wind 1-9 mph; trees from 3DEP lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme worcester_cc (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (831 x 1213 m, way/87279910) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (224 m west/east, 161 m south/north)
